title: Quick Briny Middle Eastern Ricotta Fatteh
description: A briny, gooey, indulgent middle-eastern dish featuring ricotta, deglaze-fond, and whole30-friendly ingredients, served in a binchotan-grill vessel in the form of fatteh.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the toasted pita bread cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
In a separate bowl, mix together the crumbled ricotta cheese, chopped artichoke hearts, halved cherry tomatoes, and pitted kalamata olives.
To assemble the fatteh, place a layer of the pita bread mixture in the bottom of the binchotan-grill vessel.
Top the pita bread layer with the ricotta cheese mixture and spread evenly.
Deglaze the binchotan-grill with a small amount of water to create a fond, then pour the fond over the top of the ricotta cheese mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of pita bread on top.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top layer of pita bread is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
